node.name: Find practice from the file name prefix
node.logic: Practice name = FILE.ReceivedFileName after the last backslash, up to the first underscore. GetPracticeConfigurationByName. If pcInstanceAddress is empty, each claim logs 'Connection String not found for Claim {0} in File {1}' to BTS.Log through Common.AddLog.
